data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the opening of the year (1 January 2018) were $774.714m. During 2018 there was an overall favourable prior-year reserve movement (an over-provision) of $21.778m (gross), recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation as "Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses (21,778)". The movement has been interpreted as favourable claims development; the report does not quantify detailed per-line prior-year adjustments. Current-year catastrophe activity (eg. Hurricanes Florence and Michael) is noted as causing modest losses in 2018 but these are described separately from the prior-year release.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts reported are in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening reserves (gross claims outstanding) taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions: Claims outstanding) and prior-year development taken from Technical Provisions reconciliation row labelled 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (gross column). Prior-year movement is explicitly gross and used as reported. The report gives limited narrative explanation for the cause of the prior-year release; 'favourable claims development' is inferred. Named events (Hurricanes Florence and Michael) are mentioned as 2018 losses but are not quantified for prior-year movement. All monetary figures in the notes are presented in thousands; opening_reserves and movements have been converted to millions.
